name: Should I repair or replace my shower faucet?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my shower faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace your shower faucet depends on several factors, including the age of the faucet, the severity of the problem, and the cost of repair versus replacement. If your faucet is old, has frequent issues, or if replacement parts are hard to find, a full replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. Conversely, a newer faucet with a minor issue is usually a good candidate for repair. We can provide an honest assessment, helping you weigh the practical tradeoffs between a short-term fix and a longer-term solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider repair for minor issues on newer faucets, or replacement for older faucets with frequent problems or hard-to-find parts.
